`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of its average daily sales. `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of the file for when you switch suppliers.

I ran it on the current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has 9 on hand against about 14 expected to sell in 6 days, and oat milk has 30 against 45. `OUT` still shows for anything already at zero.

Because the report runs nightly, an item is usually first flagged when it has between 5 and 6 days of stock left, so ordering that night can still leave the shelf empty for up to a day. Setting `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 would close that gap by flagging a day earlier; I left it at 6 as you asked.
